flrender.option.quality.tooltip:
How much our mods' effects may cost (anomalies, portals, eyes, screen effects).
Low - the plain, flat ways, for a weak computer.
Medium - more per-pixel detail.
High - all the main things.
Ultra - everything at its best.
Below, each technique can be switched on or off by itself (Auto = as the quality says).
flrender.detect.chosen: FL Render: effects quality set to "%s" for your computer. Change it: Options > Video Settings > FL Render tab.
flrender.detect.lowered: FL Render: %s frames per second on average - effects quality lowered to "%s". Change it: Options > Video Settings > FL Render.
Burning and glowing effects (anomalies, portals) light up the ground and walls round them in their colour. The picture only: the world's light levels don't change. Nearest lights: medium 4, high 8, ultra 12.
